H1500.def: feminine of «01498» and mean the same: -that (he had robbed) (which he took violently away), spoil, violence.

H1501.et: from an unused root meaning to devour
H1501.def: from an unused root meaning to devour; a kind of locust:--palmer-worm.

H1502.def: from the same as «01501»; devourer:--Gazzam, one of the Nethinim:--Gazzam.

H1503.et: from an unused root meaning to cut down (trees)
H1503.def: from an unused root meaning to cut down (trees); the trunk or stump of a tree (as felled or as planted):--stem, stock.

H1504.def: a primitive root; to cut down or off; (figuratively) to destroy, divide, exclude, or decide:--cut down (off), decree, divide, snatch.

H1505.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «01504»; to quarry; determine:--cut out, soothsayer.

H1506.def: from «01504»; something cut off; a portion:--part, piece.

H1507.def: the same as «01506»; Gezer, a place in Palestine:--Gazer, Gezer.

H1508.def: feminine of «01506»; the figure or person (as if cut out); also an inclosure (as separated):--polishing, separate place.

H1511.def: (in the m patrial from «01507»; a Gezerite (collectively) or inhabitants of Gezer; but better (as in the text) by transposition Girziy {gher-zee'}; patrial of «01630»; a Grizite (collectively) or member of a native tribe in Palestine:--Gezrites.

H1512.def: probably from «01518»; the external abdomen, belly (as the source of the faetus (compare «01521»)):--belly.

H1513.def: or (feminine) gacheleth {gah-kheh'-leth}; from an unused root meaning to glow or kindle; an ember:--(burning) coal.

H1514.et: from an unused root meaning to burn
H1514.def: from an unused root meaning to burn; flame; Gacham, a son of Nahor:--Gaham.

H1515.et: from an unused root meaning to hide
H1515.def: from an unused root meaning to hide; lurker; Gachar, one of the Nethinim:--Gahar.

H1516.et: probably from the same root as (01466) (abbreviated)
H1516.def: or (shortened) gay {gah'-ee}; probably (by transmutation) from the same root as «01466» (abbreviated); a gorge (from its lofty sides; hence, narrow, but not a gully or winter-torrent):--valley.

H1517.def: probably from «01464»; a thong (as compressing); by analogy, a tendon:--sinew.

H1518.def: or (shortened) goach {go'-akh}; a primitive root; to gush forth (as water), generally to issue:--break forth, labor to bring forth, come forth, draw up, take out.

H1519.def: (Aramaic) or (shortened) guwach (Aramaic) {goo'- akh}; corresponding to «01518»; to rush forth:--strive.

H1520.def: from «01518»; a fountain; Giach, a place in Palestine:--Giah.

H1521.def: or (shortened) Gichown {ghee-khone'}; from «01518»; stream; Gichon, a river of Paradise; also a valley (or pool) near Jerusalem:--Gihon.

H1522.def: or Gechaziy {gay-khah-zee'}; apparently from «01516» and «02372»; valley of a visionary; Gechazi, the servant of Elisha:--Gehazi.

H1523.def: or (by permutation) guwl {gool}; a primitive root; properly, to spin round (under the influence of any violent emotion), i.e. usually rejoice, or (as cringing) fear:--be glad, joy, be joyful, rejoice.

H1524.def: from «01523»; a revolution (of time, i.e. an age); also joy:--X exceedingly, gladness, × greatly, joy, rejoice(-ing), sort.

H1525.def: or giylath {ghee-lath'}; feminine of «01524»; joy:--joy, rejoicing.

H1526.def: patrial from «01542»; a Gilonite or inhabitant of Giloh:--Gilonite.

H1527.def: of uncertain derivation; Ginath, an Israelite:--Ginath.

H1529.def: from the same as «01487»; lumpish; Geshan, an Israelite:--Geshan.

H1530.def: from «01556»; something rolled, i.e. a heap of stone or dung (plural ruins), by analogy, a spring of water (plural waves):--billow, heap, spring, wave.

H1531.def: from «01556»; a cup for oil (as round):--bowl.

H1532.et: from an unused root meaning to shave
H1532.def: from an unused root meaning to shave; a barber:--barber.

H1533.def: from «01530» and «01158»; fountain of ebullition; Gilboa, a mountain of Palestine:--Gilboa.

H1534.def: by reduplication from «01556»; a wheel; by analogy, a whirlwind; also dust (as whirled):--heaven, rolling thing, wheel.

H1537.def: the same as «01536» (with the article as a properly, noun); Gilgal, the name of three places in Palestine:--Gilgal. See also «01019».

H1538.def: by reduplication from «01556»; a skull (as round); by implication, a head (in enumeration of persons):--head, every man, poll, skull.

H1539.et: from an unused root probably meaning to polish
H1539.def: from an unused root probably meaning to polish; the (human) skin (as smooth):--skin.

H1540.def: a primitive root; to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication, to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively, to reveal:--+ advertise, appear, bewray, bring, (carry, lead, go) captive (into captivity), depart, disclose, discover, exile, be gone, open, × plainly, publish, remove, reveal, × shamelessly, shew, × surely, tell, uncover.

H1541.def: (Aramaic) or glat (Aramaic) {ghel-aw'}; corresponding to «01540»:--bring over, carry away, reveal.

H1542.def: or (fully) Giyloh {ghee-lo'}; from «01540»; open; Giloh, a place in Palestine:--Giloh.

H1543.def: feminine from «01556»; a fountain, bowl or globe (all as round):--bowl, pommel, spring.

H1544.def: or (shortened) gillul {ghil-lool'}; from «01556»; properly, a log (as round); by implication, an idol:--idol.

H1546.def: feminine from «01540»; captivity; concretely, exiles (collectively):--(they that are carried away) captives(-ity).

H1548.def: a primitive root; properly, to be bald, i.e. (causatively) to shave; figuratively to lay waste:--poll, shave (off).

H1549.def: or gilyown {ghil-yone'}; from «01540»; a tablet for writing (as bare); by analogy, a mirror (as a plate):--glass, roll.

H1550.def: from «01556»; a valve of a folding door (as turning); also a ring (as round):--folding, ring.

H1551.def: or (prolonged) Galiylah {gaw-lee-law'}; the same as «01550»; a circle (with the article); Galil (as a special circuit) in the North of Palestine:--Galilee.

H1552.def: feminine of «01550»; a circuit or region:--border, coast, country.

H1553.def: plural of «01552»; circles; Geliloth, a place in Palestine:--Geliloth.

H1554.def: plural of «01530»; springs; Gallim, a place in Palestine:--Gallim.

H1555.def: perhaps from «01540»; exile; Goljath, a Philistine:--Goliath.

H1556.def: a primitive root; to roll (literally or figuratively):--commit, remove, roll (away, down, together), run down, seek occasion, trust, wallow.

H1558.def: from «01556»; a circumstance (as rolled around); only used adverbially, on account of:--because of, for (sake).

H1559.def: from «01556», in the sense of «01560»; great; Galal, the name of two Israelites:--Galal.

H1560.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «01556»; weight or size (as if rolled):--great.

H1561.def: a variation of «01557»; dung (plural balls of dung):--dung.

H1563.def: a primitive root; to fold:--wrap together.

H1564.def: from «01563»; a wrapped (and unformed mass, i.e. as the embryo):--substance yet being unperfect.

H1565.def: probably by prolonged from «01563»; sterile (as wrapped up too hard); figuratively, desolate:--desolate, solitary.

H1566.def: a primitive root; to be obstinate:--(inter-)meddle (with).

H1567.def: from «01530» and «05707»; heap of testimony; Galed, a memorial cairn East of the Jordan:--Galeed.

H1568.def: probably from «01567»; Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites:--Gilead, Gileadite.

H1569.def: patronymically from «01568»; a Giladite or descendant of Gilad:--Gileadite.

H1570.def: a primitive root; probably to caper (as a goat):--appear.

H1571.et: by contraction from an unused root
H1571.def: by contraction from an unused root meaning to gather; properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and:--again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and , but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.

H1572.def: a primitive root (literally or figuratively) to absorb:--swallow, drink.

H1573.def: from «01572»; properly, an absorbent, i.e. the bulrush (from its porosity); specifically the papyrus:--(bul-)rush.

H1574.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to grasp
H1574.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to grasp; properly, a span:--cubit.

H1575.def: from the same as «01574»; a warrior (as grasping weapons):--Gammadims.

H1576.def: from «01580»; treatment, i.e. an act (of good or ill); by implication, service or requital:--+ as hast served, benefit, desert, deserving, that which he hath given, recompense, reward.

H1577.def: passive participle of «01580»; rewarded; Gamul, an Israelite:--Gamul. See also «01014».

H1578.def: feminine of «01576»; meaning the same:--deed, recompense, such a reward.

H1579.def: of uncertain derivation; Gimzo, a place in Palestine:--Gimzo.

H1580.def: a primitive root; to treat a person (well or ill), i.e. benefit or requite; by implication (of toil), to ripen, i.e. (specifically) to wean:--bestow on, deal bountifully, do (good), recompense, requite, reward, ripen, + serve, mean, yield.

H1581.def: apparently from «01580» (in the sense of labor or burden-bearing); a camel:--camel.

H1582.def: probably from «01581»; camel-driver; Gemalli, an Israelite:--Gemalli.

H1583.def: from «01580» and «0410»; reward of God; Gamliel, an Israelite:--Gamaliel.

H1584.def: a primitive root; to end (in the sense of completion or failure):--cease, come to an end, fail, perfect, perform.

H1586.def: from «01584»; completion; Gomer, the name of a son of Japheth and of his descendants; also of a Hebrewess:--Gomer.

H1587.def: or Gmaryahuw {ghem-ar-yaw'-hoo}; from «01584» and «03050»; Jah has perfected; Gemarjah, the name of two Israelites:--Gemariah.

H1589.def: a primitive root; to thieve (literally or figuratively); by implication, to deceive:--carry away, × indeed, secretly bring, steal (away), get by stealth.

H1592.def: from «01589»; theft; Genubath, an Edomitish prince:--Genubath.

H1595.et: from an unused root meaning to store
H1595.def: from an unused root meaning to store; treasure; by implication, a coffer:--chest, treasury.

H1598.def: a primitive root; to hedge about, i.e. (generally) protect:--defend.

H1599.def: or Ginnthow {ghin-neth-o'}; from «01598»; gardener; Ginnethon or Ginnetho, an Israelite:--Ginnetho, Ginnethon.
